## `/fundadmin:fund investor-onboard <type>` {#investor-onboard}

Investor onboarding checklist & workflow

Prepares an onboarding checklist by investor type: documents to collect, the qualification, tax and screening reviews to run, owners and a timeline. Does not screen or admit. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund investor-onboard` or describes an incoming investor.

| Host | Invocation |

**Writes** `ONBOARDING-CHECKLIST-[fund]-[type]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-investor-onboard/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund ddq-respond <file>` {#ddq-respond}

DDQ/RFP response drafting from templates

Drafts answers to an investor DDQ or RFP mapped to the 20 ILPA DDQ 2.0 topics, citing sources, grading answers A-F and flagging questions that need human input. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund ddq-respond`, asks to answer a DDQ, or shares a due diligence questionnaire.

**Writes** `DDQ-RESPONSE-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ddq-respond/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund entity-map <file>` {#entity-map}

Fund structure & entity relationship mapping

Maps a fund structure into a Mermaid diagram, entity registry, ownership chain and fee-flow tables, flagging blocker, feeder and ERISA plan-asset gaps. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund entity-map`, asks to diagram a structure, or shares formation documents.

## `/fundadmin:fund data-room <type>` {#data-room}

Virtual data room organizer & checklist

Drafts a data room index across eight categories with Required/Recommended/Optional status, gaps from a supplied document list and NDA-gated access tiers, for human approval. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund data-room <type>` or asks how to organize a fundraising data room.
